I opened the page. The title is **"Temu | Explore the Latest Clothing, Beauty, Home, Jewelry & More"**

I couldn't see any products or categories on the page itself. Apart from that title, the page came back almost empty: just invisible characters and no visible text. That's probably because the site builds its content with JavaScript, which my tool doesn't run. I didn't get an error, block or captcha. The categories named in the title (Clothing, Beauty, Home, Jewelry) are the only ones I saw.
